notes.title: Closer to Release!
notes.content:
Hello all!

This update comes with the following:
[list]
[*] Prefab layering fixes
[*] Text fixes
[*] Light tinkering
[*] Path leading tinkering. 
[*] Added controller input UI 
[/list]

As mentioned above, the game is fully playable. However, I'm still trying to figure out how to implement the controller UI to appear over the regular keyboard txt UI, whenever a controller is connected/ disconnected. 

Thank you!
